--- clean.sv
+++ buggy.sv
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 			begin 
 				match <= 1'b0;
 			end
-		else if (a_tem == 8'b0111_0001)
+		else if (a_tem == 8'b0111_0001 && a == 1'b0)
 			begin
 				match <= 1'b1;
 			end

claims.violated_requirement: The match signal incorrectly depends on both the shift register value AND the current input bit being 0. This will fail to detect the pattern when the input bit is 1, even if the shift register contains 8'b0111_0001.
claims.spec_basis: The spec requires the match signal to be asserted whenever the shift register matches 8'b0111_0001, regardless of the current input value.

grammar_error: Syntax-token insertion/deletion is forbidden. Replace at most two existing operands/operators, or swap one existing two-operand concatenation. Do not append an if guard.
